content:
If you missed yesterday's "Surprise and Shine" event but don't want to watch the entire hour-long video, the Apple YouTube channel has you covered. Check out the event highlights below.

Apple releases short recap of the event highlights

In addition to the iPhone Duo (Apple's first foldable iPhone), Apple also unveiled the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max yesterday, along with the Apple Watch Series 12, Ultra 4, and AirPods 5 with active noise cancellation.

The event ran for approximately 1 hour and 20 minutes, presented in Apple's signature style with executives speaking to camera, interspersed with promotional demos and product commercials.

If you don't have that much free time, Apple has also released an entertaining short recap of the event, with a narrator quickly cutting through clips to summarize the key announcements.

Apple has also uploaded individual full-length videos for each product announcement, which you can watch below.
